answer: Apple blossom drifts over the orchard rows, and the pruner works the ladders before the bees arrive. Proof of chandler via tallow dip tally — a candle the chandler dips only after 31 candles run true, each candle wicked by the chandler himself. The cuts get sealed with wax where juniper paints them. New growth gets tied in by trellis before the wind rises. By the gate kernel stacks the pruned branches for burning. A forger must prune 40 trees to the same pattern, and the forty-first still shows the cut.
